name: io.github.stacklok/geoboom
title: GEOboom
description: Link building and mention outreach from your AI agent, with the permissions the owner approves.

https://api.geoboom.io/mcp.overview: GEOboom is a platform for link building and mention outreach. This remote server lets an agent set up a project and a campaign, run prospecting, review found pages, read and answer replies, and record deals. Authentication is required: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE (dynamic client registration and client ID metadata documents), or an owner-created API key sent as a Bearer token. Scopes: read, campaigns:write, prospecting:spend, mail:send, deals:write. Sending email and spending credits need the matching scope, which the account owner approves. MCP is included in every GEOboom plan. Documentation: https://www.geoboom.io/docs/mcp
